name: Enable ECN
description: Enables Explicit Congestion Notification on the Windows TCP stack for Internet connections to improve network flow management.

description_i18n.en: Enables Explicit Congestion Notification on the Windows TCP stack for Internet connections to improve network flow management.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert die explizite Stau-Benachrichtigung im Windows-TCP-Stack für Internetverbindungen, um den Netzwerkfluss zu optimieren.
description_i18n.fr: Active la notification explicite de congestion sur le pile TCP Windows pour les connexions Internet afin d'améliorer la gestion du flux réseau.

warnings.title: required
warnings.message: This tweak requires an elevated administrator session to apply changes and modify network settings

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the EcnCapability registry value for the 'Internet' profile using Set-NetTCPSetting to set it to Enabled
